How It Works & Setup Guide

📱 Open on Your Mobile Phone

Because you are running with --host, you can open this page on any phone or tablet connected to your local Wi-Fi!

Network Address: http://localhost:5173

💡 Tip: On mobile, use the top tabs to quickly toggle between Channel 1, Channel 2, or both stacked!

🔑 How YouTube Live Chat Embedding Works

YouTube requires the live chat iframe to include an embed_domain parameter matching the website's exact hostname:

https://www.youtube.com/live_chat?v=[VIDEO_ID]&embed_domain=[YOUR_HOSTNAME]&dark_theme=1
  • Domain Match: The app automatically reads your current browser hostname (e.g. localhost, 127.0.0.1, or your LAN IP) and injects it into YouTube's API.
  • Cookie Support: For participating or sending messages in chat, ensure your browser allows third-party cookies for YouTube.
  • Popout Fallback: If YouTube requires direct sign-in, click the pop-out icon () in any chat header to open YouTube's native chat window.

🎥 OBS Studio Integration

Want to capture this in OBS as a Browser Source?

  1. Click OBS Mode in the top bar to strip all headers and controls.
  2. In OBS Studio, add a new Browser Source and set URL to your local server URL (e.g. http://localhost:5173).
  3. Set Width: 800 or 1920, Height: 1080.
